name: Overturn
description: Overturn for Front: captures what the AI drafted, what the teammate sent, and why, as a replayable case

settings.name: overturn_api_key
settings.description: Project API key from Overturn (Settings → API keys).

settings.name: agent
settings.description: The workflow name. One regression suite per workflow.

settings.name: require_reason

settings.name: decision_fields

settings.description: Optional tag to restrict watched conversations.

settings.name: min_draft_chars
settings.description: Minimum characters to count as draft.
